alerte.texte: Four more merged: relative dates, offline privacy, the vote cost (a vote change now costs 374 ms of jank instead of 1,443), and the removal of this morning's Explore pager rule, which made black pages worse. That makes 43 build 196 fixes merged today. One slip on my side: I merged the vote cost fix before the re-measurement of its last version came back. That measurement is still running, and I remove the fix if it shows anything worse. The map preparation stays out of this build.

depuis.texte: Changing your vote no longer redraws the whole feed: the jank of a vote change goes from 1,443 ms to 374 ms.
Privacy settings chosen offline survive an app kill and reach the server when the network is back. In a conflict, the most private choice wins.
Explore: removes this morning's native pager rule, which made black pages far worse (0 black frames before it, 174 after). The root defect is reopened for after this build.
Dates: a prefetch no longer redraws every relative date. Date renders during a prefetch go from 7 to 0, and jank from 195 ms to 0.
